statement_pretty:
∀ {α : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrder α] [inst_3 : SuccOrder α] {a b : α},
  a < Order.succ b → max (Order.succ b) (Order.succ a) = Order.succ b

While its immediate utility outside the present formal context remains speculative, the structural coupling of hypotheses is unexpectedly persistent.

Although the statement clears the Level 1 lookup gate across Order, sup_of_le_left, the conclusion reads primarily as an accidental consequence of chaining 3 library facts. I recommend publication solely as a lemma of modest significance (3/10), noting that the kernel's indifference to mathematical taste is on full display.
